Created files become FileInfo+Destination migration records in memory; enqueue exceptions are logged.

Under shared semaphore: commit process_info first, move file second, store MD5(MD5(file)+LOCAL salt), then best-effort timed transmission enqueue. Exceptions are logged and loop continues; cancellation is checked at loop head.
Move original into configured transmission work directory under decimal process_info.id (not its original extension).

Periodic backlog scan runs only online; timer stops around scan and restarts.
IPv4/IPv6 Internet connectivity flags trigger backlog scan; disconnection logs a warning.
Reconcile work files with DB under semaphore, process destinations by descending monitoring priority, abort iteration on cancellation, continue after per-destination exceptions.
A matching original-id file is eligible when retry_schedule absent or due; unreferenced work files are deleted unless referenced as compressed artifacts.
Rows with no decimal-id original file are removed during reconciliation.

StopExecute or nonzero MSK status suppresses upload. Validate original/compressed payload, persist validation, refresh proxy then request; success records duplicate digest then deletes files/row; retry schedules delay, max attempts disposes, special MSK results suspend uploads and notify PF.
Fresh original checks extension/size/duplicate/JSON header; previously validated original rechecks duplicate+tampering; compressed checks size on first validation or tampering on reuse.
Enabled destination validators all must pass; no unconditional file-type inference from filename alone.
CompressionMethod 1=Zstandard, 2=GZip; method 0 uses original through CheckCompressionStatus. Reuse existing compressed artifact if recorded and present.
Request metadata fields FileName,Version,DataType,CompressionMethod,Checksum,HashAlgorithm,FileSize. Checksum is SHA256(SHA256(transmitted bytes)+GLOBAL salt), not plain file SHA256.
Multipart logInfo JSON and logFile binary; binary alias restores original name plus compression suffix.

Each destination gets Basic authorization and X-GUID; timeout uses config. Empty proxy uses parameterless HttpClient at IL0065. Proxy branch constructs HttpClient(HttpMessageHandler) at IL00ED from configured handler; overload signatures are retained.

evidence.cancellation_contract: Two-argument PostAsync(uri,content) carries no CancellationToken. Controller cancellation stops queue/backlog iteration, not this in-flight request; request timeout is30000ms, controller abort wait15000ms.
evidence.finding: MSK loaded locally if missing and added as X-MSK when nonempty. Deserialize response before HTTP check. HTTP200 => result1; configured retry status =>2; HTTP403/MIR4030001=>4(expired); HTTP400/MIR4000000=>5(revoked); other=>3. Exceptions produce retry2 with timeout/communication/unexpected delay. Inner request loop count is config-bounded.
HTTP retry eligibility/delay comes from configured status list; not hardcoded broad 5xx retry.
Retry update always sets is_retryable=true; its boolean argument controls incrementing attempts, not retryability. OperateFile passes false for HTTP401, so 401 does not consume attempts.
Acknowledged success deletes compressed/original files before removing DB row.
Validation and terminal transmission errors apply distinct destination disposal policies then delete queue row.
DisposalType=2 evacuates; other values delete immediately.
Evacuation deletes compression artifact and moves original to configured evacuation/id/original_filename, replacing existing destination.
Disposal skips is_retryable=true. Nonretryable rows expire at CreatedAt+configured duration; then delete or evacuate and remove row. Missing originals also remove compression/row.
Clean evacuation directories only when disposal type2 and AllowCleaning; validation/transmission evacuation paths are handled separately.
Evacuation subdirectory LastWriteTime+common retention duration must be earlier than now; in-use IOException skips directory.

DataSync logs are copied, randomized delay applied, single log renamed or multiple logs merged once-header, moved into configured logging destination watch root; history updated then copied/source logs deleted.
Logging filename pattern GTSPlusDataSync*.log; export names GUID_firstdate_lastdate.log or GUID_date.log.
LoggingTask is enabled only when DSY-D01 destination exists; deployed C02/E02/M02 policy has no DSY-D01, so optional log packaging is inactive.

Result/error serializes ECUResultData XML and encrypts to output; encryption return boolean is popped and exceptions swallowed, then next-page returns true.
Default result beside input: inputstem_timestamp.rlog, collision suffix (n); user can override output. This is a local encrypted action log, not DataSync queue format.
Envelope: native-endian Int16 wrapped-key length (little-endian on target Windows), RSA-wrapped random AES key, AES IV, AES-CBC PKCS7 ciphertext; output false on caught exception.
Action result uses generated 16-byte random AES key encrypted by RSA public key, never an account credential.
ECUSendData defaults Version to1.0.0 and initializes VIN/Commands collections.
ECUResultData defaults Version to1.0.0 and initializes VIN/Data collections.

CREATE TABLE "hash_info" (
    "original_hash_value" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    "destination" varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    "created_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
    "created_at" datetimeoffset NOT NULL,
    "updated_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,

    "history_id" varchar(6) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_logging_history" PRIMARY KEY,
    "file_name" varchar(33) NULL,

    "created_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
    "created_at" datetimeoffset NOT NULL,
    "updated_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
    "updated_at" datetimeoffset NOT NULL
)

    "id" integer NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_process_info" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "destination" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    "unit_id" varchar(32) NULL,
    "original_file_name" varchar(260) NOT NULL,
    "original_hash_value" varchar(32) NULL,
    "original_extension" varchar(10) NULL,
    "compressed_file_path" varchar(260) NULL,
    "compressed_hash_value" varchar(32) NULL,
    "is_validated" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "is_retryable" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "retry_schedule" datetimeoffset NULL,
    "request_attempts" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "created_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
    "created_at" datetimeoffset NOT NULL,
    "updated_by" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
    "updated_at" datetimeoffset NOT NULL
)
